Good but not flawless
Apr 2024 • Friends
A bit hidden in a side street in Saigon. A small and cozy restaurant that mainly serves meat, but you can also enjoy pasta.

The food itself was not bad and the service was friendly. However, there are a number of flaws that can easily be remedied.

1/ we were 7 people and requested some cocktails in advance as an aperitif. We had clearly asked for the cocktails to be served in advance but they arrived together with the food...
(fortunately this was corrected upon our request)

2/ Mojito is not made with brown rum but with white rum. The taste is completely different...

3/ we ordered a bottle of Chilean wine but it was no longer in stock. There was also no French alternative. Then an Italian one. It was ok but poured very clumsily.

Afterwards we received a dessert from the company, very thoughtful.

Without mistakes I would certainly have given it a 4.

Very nice restaurant at the urban
Dec 2020 • Couples
As you enter the place you are welcomed by a magnificent setting, a delightful Christmas decoration. 

The menu offers a wide variety of mouth-watering starters. I had the Portuguese Satay Beef, Pumpkin soup, while my friend tried the Fish and Chip, Beef Salad. They were exquisite. The main course consisted in a US Beef with grilled vegetables, bolognese pasta and the four kind of steak which really thrilled us. It all was followed by a chocolate lava cake for dessert but it isn’t too delicious.

❗What a pity that the bolognese pasta have some pieces of paper 😣
